This works for me:

library(shinydashboard)

dashboardPage(skin = "red",
  dashboardHeader(title = img(src="logo.jpg", height = 50, align = "right")),
  dashboardSidebar(fileInput('file1', 'Choose CSV File',
                             accept=c('.csv'))),
  dashboardBody()
)
